scientific_integrity: The entire mathematical assertion is established analytically using sourced rotation-staircase and plateau formulas, a uniform geometric-series bound, and classical reduced-rational counting; finite exact-rational checks do not prove the universal statements.
scientific_limitations: Only compact rotation windows inside the allowed range enjoy the uniform logarithmic covering estimate; no full-window box-count assertion at the expanding critical endpoint. The theorem gives a sharp order but not an exact leading constant, and does not establish sharp Hausdorff gauge measures. Historical priority is provisional pending independent literature audit.
title: Sharp logarithmic covering law for irrational rotation parameters of two-slope interval maps
